description: Unmodified MIT-licensed shadcn-svelte sources (licence: src/lib/LICENSE.md), copied from the north-star checkout (conformance/corpus/north-star.json) so that the fixture builds without it; tests/bits.test.mjs checks the hashes, and the files against .cache/corpus when it is fetched. The app (src/App.svelte) and its theme (src/app.css) are this repository's. bits-ui is compiled from its published package (node_modules/bits-ui at the version the north star's lockfile pins).
